rules.check: Every modified extension has exactly one base-relative version bump.
Each modified extension's changelog delta is one Jira-free final-state entry at the end of its applicable section.
Root changelog delta is one concise final-state entry at the end of its applicable Unreleased section, prefixed by supplied Jira only.
Changed behavior, setup, API, and workflow documentation describes the submitted final state.
Each changed behavior that cannot be exercised meaningfully by a unit test has integration or E2E coverage.
Submitted full-lint evidence includes Ruff's actual remaining-error count rather than only a wrapper summary.
Every submitted failed test, build, lint, or changelog job has inspected failure output and an explicit disposition.
Launcher workflow changes preserve equivalent Windows/POSIX behavior through paired entry points or one verified polyglot entry point.
Launcher workflow changes preserve debug and release behavior when both variants exist.
Required formatter evidence exists for the exact reviewed head SHA.
Required full-lint evidence exists for the exact reviewed head SHA.
Required relevant-test and measured-coverage evidence exists for the exact reviewed head SHA.
Required applicable build and changelog-job evidence exists for the exact reviewed head SHA.
Green CI is never treated as a substitute for static review.
